newsitem.title: UK: Strikes at Cadbury Bournville plant planned.
newsitem.headline: Strikes at Cadbury Bournville plant planned.

text.p: About 800 workers at the Cadbury Schweppes Plc Bournville moulded chocolate plant in the UK plan two-day strikes in June to protest changes in shift patterns, said Doug Lee, a works convenor for the Transport and General Workers Union (TGWU).
"The next planned action is on June 3 and 4 and then on the 11th and 12th," Lee said on Tuesday. The union's first 48-hour strike started at 0600 GMT on Sunday.

The dispute centres around accrued hours. Originally, workers had a 168-hour per month shift, or 42-hour week. But they were only paid for a 39-hour week and compensated for the extra hours with extra days, which workers could accrue and either take time off in lieu or receive extra pay.
But the company has abolished that system in favour of giving fixed days off instead. Lee said the company had offered 10 fixed days off next year and 12 the following year.
No talks with the company have taken place yet, and Lee said none are yet slated.
